sentences.text: At the time of commission of alleged offence she was merely 16 years of age.
FIR was lodged on 02.05.2022 by the police promptly and after more than six months chargesheet was not filed.
The first bail application of the opposite party no. 2 was got dismissed as not pressed but his second bail application was allowed by the court below on 15.06.2022.
Thereafter statement of the victim was recorded under section 164 Cr.P.C., wherein she made clear allegation against the opposite party no. 2.
The findings recorded while granting bail to the opposite party no. 2 are against the correct facts on record.
It has been prayed that the bail granted to the opposite party no. 2 may be cancelled.
4. Counsel for the opposite party no. 2 has submitted that date of incident is mentioned as 04.10.2018 but FIR was lodged on 02.05.2022.
The victim was major at the time of offence.
The investigating officer after recording the statements of the victim and her father filed charge-sheet in accordance with law.

In case, the first bail application of the opposite party no. 2 was dismissed as not pressed, there was no bar for filing the second bail application, since the first bail application was not rejected on merit.
It was argued, considered and decided on merit.
No good ground has been made for cancelling bail granted to the opposite party no. 2 by the court below.
5. After hearing the rival submissions, this Court finds that the second bail application of the applicant was decided on merits as per the law.
It is not the case of the applicant that the opposite party no. 2 ever misused liberty of bail granted to him.
It is also not alleged that he is not cooperating with the trial or has threatened any witness in trial.
6. The bail cancellation application is rejected.

7. The trial court is directed to conclude the trial against the applicant as expeditiously as possible,
preferable within a period of one year from the date of production of certified copy of this order.
8.
Registrar (compliance) is directed to communicate this order to the trial Court for necessary compliance within ten days.
